mentions.note: 前文“I had intended “The Adventure of the Abbey Grange” to be the last of those exploits of”与后文同位语“, Mr. Sherlock Holmes”表明叙述者华生称呼挚友福尔摩斯（g001）。
前文“last of those exploits of my friend,”与后文“, which I should ever communicate to the public”表明指华生记录其探案事迹的歇洛克·福尔摩斯（g001）。
前文“since he has definitely retired from”与后文“and betaken himself to study and bee-farming on the Sussex Downs”表明指福尔摩斯退休前执业所在的伦敦（g015）。
前文“The one, austere, high-nosed, eagle-eyed, and dominant, was none other than the illustrious”与后文“, twice Premier of Britain”表明指来访贝克街的英国首相贝林杰勋爵（g003）。
前文“was none other than the illustrious Lord Bellinger, twice”与后文“of Britain”作为同位职务头衔，指代两度出任英国首相的贝林杰勋爵（g003）。
前文“was none other than the illustrious Lord Bellinger, twice Premier of”与后文“. The other, dark, clear-cut, and elegant”表明指贝林杰勋爵任首相的国家英国（g024）。
前文“endowed with every beauty of body and of mind, was the Right Honourable”与后文“, Secretary for European Affairs, and the most rising statesman”表明指另一位来访者欧洲事务大臣特里劳尼·霍普（g004）。
前文“it was business of the most pressing importance which had brought them.”与后文“’s thin, blue-veined hands were clasped tightly over the ivory head of his umbrella”表明指紧握伞柄的首相贝林杰勋爵（g003）。
前文“his gaunt, ascetic face looked gloomily from”与后文“to me. The European Secretary pulled nervously at his moustache”表明首相的目光从福尔摩斯（g001）转向华生。
前文“his gaunt, ascetic face looked gloomily from Holmes to me.”与后文“pulled nervously at his moustache and fidgeted with the seals of his watch-chain”表明指紧张捻胡须的欧洲事务大臣特里劳尼·霍普（g004）。
前文“When I discovered my loss,”与后文“, which was at eight o’clock this morning, I at once informed the Prime Minister”表明霍普正在向福尔摩斯（g001）陈述失窃经过。

前文“When I discovered my loss, Mr. Holmes, which was at eight o’clock this morning, I at once informed the”与后文“. It was at his suggestion that we have both come to you”表明指霍普第一时间通报并建议同来求助的首相贝林杰勋爵（g003）。

前文“It was at his suggestion that we have both come to you.”

“Have you informed”与后文“?”

“No, sir,” said the Prime Minister”表明此处“the police”泛指警方机构，非特定单一实体。

前文““Have you informed the police?”

“No, sir,” said the”与后文“, with the quick, decisive manner for which he was famous”表明指以果断口吻回答未报警的首相贝林杰勋爵（g003）。
前文“We have not done so, nor is it possible that we should do so. To inform”与后文“must, in the long run, mean to inform the public”表明此处“the police”泛指警察机构，非特定个体。
前文““I understand. Now,”与后文“, I should be much obliged if you would tell me exactly the circumstances under which this document disappeared.””表明福尔摩斯请失主特里劳尼·霍普（g004）详述文件失踪经过。

前文霍普自述“The despatch-box had stood beside the glass upon my dressing-table all night. I am a light sleeper, and so is”与后文“. We are both prepared to swear that no one could have entered the room”表明“my wife”指霍普的妻子希尔达夫人（g005）。

前文““Who did know of the existence of that letter?”

“No one in the house.”

“Surely”与后文“knew?”

“No, sir. I had said nothing to my wife”表明福尔摩斯向霍普询问其妻子希尔达夫人（g005）是否知情。

前文““Surely your wife knew?”

“No, sir. I had said nothing to”与后文“until I missed the paper this morning.””表明霍普回答在今晨发现丢信前未向妻子希尔达夫人（g005）提及。

前文““No, sir. I had said nothing to my wife until I missed the paper this morning.””与后文“nodded approvingly.

“I have long known, sir, how high is your sense of public duty,” said he”表明指点头赞许霍普保密原则的首相贝林杰勋爵（g003）。

前文““I am convinced that in the case of a secret of this importance it would rise superior to the most intimate domestic ties.””与后文“bowed.

“You do me no more than justice, sir.””表明指受首相称赞后鞠躬致意的欧洲事务大臣特里劳尼·霍普（g004）。

前文欧洲事务大臣霍普说“Until this morning I have never breathed one word to”与后文“upon this matter.”

“Could she have guessed?”表明“my wife”指霍普之妻希尔达夫人（g005）。

前文“the pledge of secrecy which attends every Cabinet meeting was increased by the solemn warning which was given by the”与后文“. Good heavens, to think that within a few hours I should myself have lost it!”表明指在内阁会议上发出庄重保密警告的首相贝林杰勋爵（g003）。

前文““But abroad?”

“I believe that no one abroad has seen it save”与后文“who wrote it. I am well convinced that his Ministers—that the usual official channels have not been employed.””中“the man”为带定语从句“who wrote it”的普通名词中心语，指代文中隐去真名的外国君主，不作专名实体。

前文“I am well convinced that his Ministers—that the usual official channels have not been employed.””与后文“considered for some little time.

“Now, sir, I must ask you more particularly what this document is”表明指沉思片刻后进一步追问信件内容的福尔摩斯（g001）。

前文“The two statesmen exchanged a quick glance and the”与后文“’s shaggy eyebrows gathered in a frown.

“Mr. Holmes, the envelope is a long, thin one”表明指浓眉紧蹙的首相贝林杰勋爵（g003）。

前文“the Premier’s shaggy eyebrows gathered in a frown.

“”与后文“, the envelope is a long, thin one of pale blue colour.”表明首相正对福尔摩斯（g001）描述信封外观。

前文“I regret exceedingly that I cannot help you in this matter, and any continuation of this interview would be a waste of time.””与后文“sprang to his feet with that quick, fierce gleam of his deep-set eyes before which a Cabinet has cowered”表明指闻言勃然起身的首相贝林杰勋爵（g003）。
前文“Then I will tell you, relying entirely upon your honour and that of”与后文同位语“, Dr. Watson. I may appeal to your patriotism also”表明首相向福尔摩斯提及的“你的同僚”即华生医生（g002）。
前文“relying entirely upon your honour and that of your colleague,”与后文“. I may appeal to your patriotism also”表明指在场旁听的华生医生（g002）。
前文“within a week of the publication of that letter this country would be involved in a great war.””与后文“wrote a name upon a slip of paper and handed it to the Premier”表明指在纸条上写出外国君主名字递给首相的福尔摩斯（g001）。

前文“Holmes wrote a name upon a slip of paper and handed it to the”与后文“.

“Exactly. It was he.”表明指接过纸条确认君主身份的首相贝林杰勋爵（g003）。

前文“Why should anyone desire to steal it or to publish it?”

“There,”与后文“, you take me into regions of high international politics.”表明首相在回答福尔摩斯（g001）关于盗信动机的提问。
前文“But if you consider the European situation you will have no difficulty in perceiving the motive. The whole of”与后文“is an armed camp. There is a double league”表明指处于武装对峙局势中的整个欧洲（g023）。
前文“The whole of Europe is an armed camp. There is a double league which makes a fair balance of military power. Great”与后文“holds the scales. If Britain were driven into war”表明指掌握欧洲均势天平的英国（g024）。
前文“Great Britain holds the scales. If”与后文“were driven into war with one confederacy, it would assure the supremacy of the other confederacy”表明指一旦卷入战争将打破均势的英国（g024）。

前文““And to whom would this document be sent if it fell into the hands of an enemy?”

“To any of the great Chancelleries of”与后文“. It is probably speeding on its way thither at the present instant”表明指敌对势力可能将密信送往的欧洲（g023）各大国政府。

前文“It is probably speeding on its way thither at the present instant as fast as steam can take it.””与后文“dropped his head on his chest and groaned aloud. The Premier placed his hand kindly upon his shoulder”表明指垂首痛苦呻吟的失主特里劳尼·霍普（g004）。

前文“Mr. Trelawney Hope dropped his head on his chest and groaned aloud.”与后文“placed his hand kindly upon his shoulder.

“It is your misfortune, my dear fellow.”表明指拍肩安慰霍普的首相贝林杰勋爵（g003）。

前文“It is inconceivable that it was taken after eleven-thirty at night, since I understand that”与后文“and his wife were both in the room from that hour until the loss was found out”表明指十一时半后与妻子同在卧室的特里劳尼·霍普（g004）。
前文“since I understand that Mr. Hope and”与后文“were both in the room from that hour until the loss was found out”表明“his wife”指霍普的妻子希尔达夫人（g005）。

前文“What chance have we now to overtake or even to trace it? It is beyond our reach.””与后文“rose from the settee.

“What you say is perfectly logical, Mr. Holmes.”表明指从长沙发上起身回应的首相贝林杰勋爵（g003）。

前文“Let us presume, for argument’s sake, that the document was taken by”与后文“or by the valet——”

“They are both old and tried servants.””表明此处为福尔摩斯作假设推论时泛指霍普府上未具名的女仆角色，非名册或具名特定人物。

前文“Let us presume, for argument’s sake, that the document was taken by the maid or by”与后文“——”

“They are both old and tried servants.””表明此处为福尔摩斯假设推论中提到的霍普府上未具名男仆（并非卢卡斯的男仆米顿），属泛指角色。
前文““Why should he be missing?” asked the”与后文“. “He would take the letter to an Embassy in London, as likely as not.””表明指发问的欧洲事务大臣特里劳尼·霍普（g004）。
前文““Why should he be missing?” asked the European Secretary. “He would take the letter to an Embassy in”与后文“, as likely as not.””表明指外国驻伦敦（g015）的大使馆。

前文““I fancy not. These agents work independently, and their relations with the Embassies are often strained.””与后文“nodded his acquiescence.

“I believe you are right, Mr. Holmes.”表明指点头赞同福尔摩斯分析的首相贝林杰勋爵（g003）。
前文首相说“I think that your course of action is an excellent one. Meanwhile,”与后文“, we cannot neglect all our other duties on account of this one misfortune.”表明首相直呼同行的欧洲事务大臣特里劳尼·霍普（g004）。
前文“I had opened the morning paper and was immersed in a sensational crime which had occurred in”与后文“the night before, when my friend gave an exclamation”表明华生在晨报上读到前一晚发生在伦敦（g015）的命案。

前文“I had opened the morning paper and was immersed in a sensational crime which had occurred in London the night before, when”与后文“gave an exclamation, sprang to his feet, and laid his pipe down upon the mantelpiece”表明华生称呼放下烟斗跃然而起的挚友福尔摩斯（g001）。
前文“There are only those three capable of playing so bold a game—there are”与后文“, La Rothiere, and Eduardo Lucas. I will see each of them.”表明指福尔摩斯点名的三大国际间谍之一奥伯斯坦（g013）。
前文“There are only those three capable of playing so bold a game—there are Oberstein, La Rothiere, and”与后文“. I will see each of them.”表明指三大间谍之一的爱德华多·卢卡斯（g006）。

前文“I glanced at my morning paper.

“Is that”与后文“of Godolphin Street?”

“Yes.”

“You will not see him.””表明华生询问报上遇害的戈多尔芬街住客是否为爱德华多·卢卡斯（g006）。

前文“I glanced at my morning paper.

“Is that Eduardo Lucas of”与后文“?”

“Yes.”

“You will not see him.””表明指卢卡斯住所所在的戈多尔芬街（g017）。

前文“MURDER IN WESTMINSTER

A crime of mysterious character was committed last night at 16,”与后文“, one of the old-fashioned and secluded rows of eighteenth century houses”表明指命案发生地戈多尔芬街（g017）16号。

前文“This small but select mansion has been inhabited for some years by”与后文“, well-known in society circles both on account of his charming personality and because he has the well-deserved reputation of being one of the best amateur tenors”表明指戈多尔芬街16号遇害房主爱德华多·卢卡斯（g006）。

前文“he has the well-deserved reputation of being one of the best amateur tenors in the country. Mr.”与后文“is an unmarried man, thirty-four years of age, and his establishment consists of Mrs. Pringle”表明指三十四岁未婚的被害人卢卡斯（g006）。
前文“Mr. Lucas is an unmarried man, thirty-four years of age, and his establishment consists of”与后文“, an elderly housekeeper, and of Mitton, his valet”表明指卢卡斯家中的年长女管家普林格尔太太（x001）。

前文“his establishment consists of Mrs. Pringle, an elderly housekeeper, and of”与后文“, his valet. The former retires early and sleeps at the top of the house. The valet was out for the evening”表明指卢卡斯的贴身男仆约翰·米顿（g011）。
前文“The valet was out for the evening, visiting a friend at Hammersmith. From ten o’clock onward Mr.”与后文“had the house to himself.”表明指当晚十点后独自在家的卢卡斯（g006）。
前文“at a quarter to twelve Police-constable”与后文“, passing along Godolphin Street observed that the door of No. 16 was ajar”表明指巡逻经过戈多尔芬街16号发现房门虚掩的值勤警员巴雷特（g010）。
前文“at a quarter to twelve Police-constable Barrett, passing along”与后文“observed that the door of No. 16 was ajar”表明指警员巴雷特巡逻经过的戈多尔芬街（g017）。

前文“Robbery does not appear to have been the motive of the crime, for there had been no attempt to remove the valuable contents of the room.”与后文“was so well-known and popular that his violent and mysterious fate will arouse painful interest”表明指惨遭杀害的社交界名流爱德华多·卢卡斯（g006）。

前文“his violent and mysterious fate will arouse painful interest and intense sympathy in a widespread circle of friends.

“Well,”与后文“, what do you make of this?” asked Holmes, after a long pause”表明福尔摩斯看完报纸后向华生（g002）发问。
前文“The odds are enormous against its being coincidence. No figures could express them. No, my dear”与后文“, the two events are connected—_must_ be connected.”表明福尔摩斯向华生（g002）断言两起事件必定相关。

前文““But now the official police must know all.”

“Not at all. They know all they see at”与后文“. They know—and shall know—nothing of Whitehall Terrace.”表明指警方命案调查所在的戈多尔芬街（g017）。

前文“There is one obvious point which would, in any case, have turned my suspicions against”与后文“. Godolphin Street, Westminster, is only a few minutes’ walk from Whitehall Terrace.”表明指因住处邻近白厅露台而最受福尔摩斯怀疑的卢卡斯（g006）。

前文“There is one obvious point which would, in any case, have turned my suspicions against Lucas.”与后文“, Westminster, is only a few minutes’ walk from Whitehall Terrace.”表明指位于威斯敏斯特、距白厅露台仅几分钟步程的戈多尔芬街（g017）。
前文“There is one obvious point which would, in any case, have turned my suspicions against Lucas. Godolphin Street,”与后文“, is only a few minutes’ walk from Whitehall Terrace.”表明指戈多尔芬街所在的威斯敏斯特区（g019）。

前文“The other secret agents whom I have named live in the extreme West End. It was easier, therefore, for”与后文“than for the others to establish a connection or receive a message from the European Secretary’s household”表明指比住在西区的其他间谍更易与欧洲事务大臣宅邸联络的卢卡斯（g006）。

前文“It was easier, therefore, for Lucas than for the others to establish a connection or receive a message from the”与后文“’s household—a small thing, and yet where events are compressed into a few hours it may prove essential.”表明指失窃宅邸主人欧洲事务大臣特里劳尼·霍普（g004）。

前文“where events are compressed into a few hours it may prove essential. Halloa! what have we here?””与后文“had appeared with a lady’s card upon her salver. Holmes glanced at it”表明指托盘递上女客名片的贝克街房东哈德森太太（g012）。

前文“Mrs. Hudson had appeared with a lady’s card upon her salver. Holmes glanced at it, raised his eyebrows, and handed it over to me.

“Ask”与后文“if she will be kind enough to step up,” said he.”表明福尔摩斯请哈德森太太引见来访的希尔达·特里劳尼·霍普夫人（g005）。

前文“our modest apartment, already so distinguished that morning, was further honoured by the entrance of the most lovely woman in”与后文“. I had often heard of the beauty of the youngest daughter of the Duke of Belminster”表明指被称为伦敦（g015）最美女性的希尔达夫人。

前文““Has my husband been here, Mr. Holmes?”

“Yes, madam, he has been here.”

“Mr. Holmes. I implore you not to tell him that I came here.””与后文“bowed coldly, and motioned the lady to a chair.”表明指冷淡鞠躬并请希尔达夫人入座的福尔摩斯（g001）。

前文““Mr. Holmes. I implore you not to tell him that I came here.” Holmes bowed coldly, and motioned”与后文“to a chair.

“Your ladyship places me in a very delicate position.””表明“the lady”指刚进门恳求保密的希尔达夫人（g005）。

前文希尔达夫人说“I will speak frankly to you in the hopes that it may induce you to speak frankly in return. There is complete confidence between”与后文“and me on all matters save one. That one is politics.”表明“my husband”指希尔达夫人的丈夫特里劳尼·霍普（g004）。
前文“I beg you then, Mr. Holmes, to tell me exactly what has happened and what it will lead to. Tell me all,”与后文“. Let no regard for your client’s interests keep you silent”表明希尔达夫人正苦苦哀求福尔摩斯（g001）告知实情。

前文希尔达夫人对福尔摩斯说“Tell me all, Mr. Holmes. Let no regard for”与后文“’s interests keep you silent, for I assure you that his interests, if he would only see it, would be best served by taking me into his complete confidence.”表明“your client”指此前委托福尔摩斯的丈夫特里劳尼·霍普（g004）。

前文福尔摩斯对希尔达夫人说““You must see that this is so, madam. If”与后文“thinks fit to keep you in the dark over this matter, is it for me, who has only learned the true facts under the pledge of professional secrecy, to tell what he has withheld?”表明“your husband”指隐瞒实情的特里劳尼·霍普（g004）。

前文““What is it, madam?”

“Is”与后文“’s political career likely to suffer through this incident?””表明希尔达夫人询问其丈夫特里劳尼·霍普（g004）的政治前途是否会受损。

前文“I had a last impression of that beautiful haunted face, the startled eyes, and the drawn mouth. Then she was gone.

“Now,”与后文“, the fair sex is your department,” said Holmes, with a smile”表明希尔达夫人离开后福尔摩斯向华生（g002）打趣询问看法。

前文““Surely her own statement is clear and her anxiety very natural.”

“Hum! Think of her appearance,”与后文“—her manner, her suppressed excitement, her restlessness, her tenacity in asking questions.”表明福尔摩斯提醒华生（g002）注意希尔达夫人的反常神态。
前文“Remember also the curious earnestness with which she assured us that it was best for”与后文“that she should know all. What did she mean by that?”表明指希尔达夫人声称应让自己知情才对他最有利的丈夫特里劳尼·霍普（g004）。
前文“What did she mean by that? And you must have observed,”与后文“, how she manœuvred to have the light at her back. She did not wish us to read her expression.”表明福尔摩斯提请华生（g002）回忆希尔达夫人背光而坐的细节。

前文“And yet the motives of women are so inscrutable. You remember”与后文“at Margate whom I suspected for the same reason. No powder on her nose—that proved to be the correct solution.”表明此处顺带提及过往马盖特旧案中一名未具名的女子，非本篇故事特定实体。

前文““You are off?”

“Yes, I will while away the morning at”与后文“with our friends of the regular establishment. With Eduardo Lucas lies the solution of our problem”表明福尔摩斯准备前往卢卡斯命案现场戈多尔芬街（g017）。

前文“I will while away the morning at Godolphin Street with our friends of the regular establishment. With”与后文“lies the solution of our problem, though I must admit that I have not an inkling as to what form it may take.”表明福尔摩斯断定破案关键在被害人爱德华多·卢卡斯（g006）身上。
前文“It is a capital mistake to theorize in advance of the facts. Do you stay on guard, my good”与后文“, and receive any fresh visitors. I’ll join you at lunch if I am able.”表明福尔摩斯出门前嘱咐华生（g002）留守贝克街。
前文“it was from the papers that I learned the particulars of the inquest, and the arrest with the subsequent release of”与后文“, the valet of the deceased.”表明指一度被捕后获释的死者男仆约翰·米顿（g011）。
前文“the arrest with the subsequent release of John Mitton,”与后文“of the deceased. The coroner’s jury brought in the obvious Wilful Murder”中“the valet”与前文“John Mitton”同位，指卢卡斯的男仆约翰·米顿（g011）。

前文“His death was an absolute mystery and likely to remain so.

As to the arrest of”与后文“, the valet, it was a council of despair as an alternative to absolute inaction.”表明指被警方权充嫌犯逮捕的男仆约翰·米顿（g011）。
前文“As to the arrest of John Mitton,”与后文“, it was a council of despair as an alternative to absolute inaction. But no case could be sustained against him.”中“the valet”作“John Mitton”的同位语，指约翰·米顿（g011）。

前文“He had visited friends in Hammersmith that night. The _alibi_ was complete. It is true that he started home at an hour which should have brought him to”与后文“before the time when the crime was discovered”表明指戈多尔芬街所在的威斯敏斯特（g019）。
